thread:
alex: Hey @tara @jordan @sam — small merge handshake for PR 84732: greedy-batcher + allocator tweak + tiny KMS header reorder. Link: https://git.local/r/redwood/pr/84732. Hoping to land tomorrow morning (~10:00 PT). Can runtime confirm no perf regression, infra sanity-check allocator flag, and security quick-approve the KMS reorder? Reply with :+1: if you can pick this up.

tara: I can run a focused perf sweep against canary for the new batcher variant. Will do a 30m run and compare p50/p99. If <3% regress we can proceed. ETA ~2h.

jordan: Quick glance at the allocator change — flag default stays the same, just a gating path. I'll queue a staging smoke with the flag on. If staging passing I'm comfortable. ETA ~1h.

sam: KMS header reorder looks straightforward but need to confirm there are no signed-request assumptions in the client. I'll grep the client libs and run a unit test. Plan to finish before EOD.

rin: dropping a note — CI flaky on the integrations today, but unit tests look green for this PR. If we rely on e2e might be delayed.

ci-bot: CI: unit-tests ✅ | integration-flaky ⚠️ | perf-run queued (#perf-4943).

alex: thanks all. I'll rebase to main and add a short allocator smoke test to the PR per jordan's suggestion. Also adding a comment noting the KMS risk for security.

tara: perf run completed: p50 +0.8%, p99 +1.9% vs baseline (same token mix). memory and GPU utilization unchanged. Summary: acceptable for canary.

jordan: staging smoke passed with allocator flag enabled. No OOMs, eviction metrics normal.

sam: security review done — client libs unaffected, signed requests still validated. Leaving one nit about a log level change. Otherwise good to approve.

alex: great — thanks everyone. I'll wait until 09:00 PT to let any late objections surface, then merge and kick the canary. If anything goes wrong I'll roll back. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Merge readiness: approvals from runtime, infra, security present. Merge hold until 09:00 PT by request.

alex: merged @09:04 PT — PR 84732 landed. Canary started: https://ci.local/canary/84732. I'll monitor dashboards for the next 2 hours and post status.

tara: monitoring dashboards now — no regressions in first 30m.

jordan: staging metrics still steady.

sam: noted, closing security thread. Thanks all. :tada:
